name: What are the key signs my roof needs replacement rather than just repairs?

mainEntity.name: What are the key signs my roof needs replacement rather than just repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key signs your roof needs replacement include widespread shingle damage like curling, buckling, or large areas of missing granules, consistent leaks in multiple places, or a roof that's visibly sagging. While minor issues can often be repaired, extensive damage or a roof nearing the end of its typical lifespan (often 20+ years for asphalt shingles) usually warrants a full replacement. Our assessment will help determine if widespread deterioration makes repairs uneconomical or ineffective.
acceptedAnswer.description: Widespread shingle damage, consistent leaks, and sagging are key signs your roof likely needs replacement over repairs.
